about: A drag of files says their types, and the shell opens files with an application (docs/adr/0035-drag-and-drop.mdx and docs/adr/0034-the-dock.mdx, 6 November 2026, protocol version 26) at 1 (1280 × 720): sample/ShellDropProbe.tsx, run as the session's shell, shows a panel of three drop targets as a dock's icons are; sample/VanishProbe.tsx drags files of the run's home and an application. foto.png held over a zone taking any files tells it its type, image/png, before any drop; dropped on the zone taking only text/markdown (what Inbox's package declares it opens) it is refused and nothing opens. The application dropped on a zone taking `application/x-oxyos-application` is delivered there by its id and, taken, does not vanish. Last, notas.md dropped on the text/markdown zone is opened with Inbox through the session (OpenFiles, citing the drop): Inbox starts with it.

steps.name: the shell's panel of drop targets, the probe's rows
foto.png held over the zone taking any files, then Escape: the zone is told its type, image/png, nothing dropped
foto.png dropped on the zone taking only text/markdown: refused, nothing opened, the image back to its row
the application dropped on the zone that keeps applications: kept there, taken, so it does not vanish
notas.md dropped on the zone taking what Inbox opens (text/markdown): the session opens it with Inbox, citing the drop
